about: The parts of the standard design/ layout that a tree of files cannot say. files/ beside this is the tree itself; design-directory.py reads both and holds no layout of its own.

meta_files.ASKS.md: the owner's asks, in their order

meta_files_note: Each lives in design/ and is created by the skill that first writes it, so a missing one is not a finding. One at the repo root is the older location.

tool_owned_dirs.vfcomments: comment threads on design documents, written by the VF Comments Obsidian plugin and the agents that follow its rule

tool_owned_dirs_note: Directories a tool creates in design/ wherever it is used. A project does not declare them and the check does not judge them.
